title: 第3218章 恐怖如此的妖孽第3217章 鸿蒙帝尊巅峰
slug: 开局长生不死谁都以为我无敌
lines: 海王族族长现在收起了所有的轻视之心，陈长安这妖孽程度，完全超出了他的所有认知。
当陈长安第一剑斩过来的那一刻，海王族族长也认真了起来。
“好小子！”
“这一剑，有力气！”
“再来！”
陈长安的速度极快，每一剑的威力都堪称恐怖。
海王族族长也是越打越兴奋，似乎遇到了难得的对手。
不知不觉间，也在一步步的提升自己的实力。
“不是！”
“我怎么感觉咱们族长有点认真了呢？”
“这叫有点认真吗？对付一个一等鸿蒙极尊境，族长都已经使出五成力了。”
“什么？五成力？那这小子怎么……”
“这人族竟然如此可怕？一等鸿蒙极尊境，竟然就可以跟使出了五成力的族长打的有来有回？”
“不是有来有回，你们难道没有发现，这个人族，完全没有感觉到压力吗？”
“你的意思是？”
“面对五成力的族长，对方完全游刃有余，想要拿下对方，恐怕，族长还得在提升一些实力才行。”
嘶！
闻听此言，四周传来了一片倒吸凉气的声音。
所有人都被陈长安的实力震惊住了，这完全就是他们无法想象的事情。
同样震惊的还有海王族族长。
“我已经使出了五成力，你的肉身，怎么会这么强？”
“其实，你可以出全力。”
“全力？”
“你确定？”
“我全力出手，动不好，可是会要命的。”
“全力，你我都出全力。”
“最后一击！”
听到陈长安的话，海王族族长犹豫了一下，但看到陈长安眼神坚定，最终还是点了点头。
“你先来，还是我先来？”
“你先！”
“那你小心了！”
海王族族长此时表情异常严肃，调动浑身修为，施展出自己的全力一击。

The leader of the Sea King Clan has now put away all his contempt. The level of Chen Changan's monster is completely beyond his understanding.
The moment Chen Changan struck with his first sword, the leader of the Sea King Clan also became serious.
"Good boy!"
"This sword is powerful!"
"Come again!"
Chen Changan's speed is extremely fast, and the power of each sword is terrifying.
The leader of the Sea King clan became more and more excited as he fought, as if he had met a rare opponent.
Unknowingly, he was also improving his strength step by step.
"No!"
"Why do I feel that our clan leader is a little serious?"
"Is this a little serious? To deal with a first-level Hongmeng Supreme Master, the clan leader has already used 50% of his strength."
"What? Fifty percent power? Then why does this kid..."
"How can this human race be so terrifying? At the level of Hongmeng Supreme Realm, you can actually fight back and forth with the clan leader who used 50% of his strength?"
"It goes back and forth, haven't you noticed that this human race doesn't feel any pressure at all?"
"What do you mean?"
"Facing the patriarch with 50% strength, the opponent is completely at ease. If you want to defeat the opponent, I'm afraid the patriarch has to improve his strength."
Hiss!
Hearing this, there was a gasp of cold air from all around.
Everyone was shocked by Chen Changan's strength. This was something they could not imagine.
Also shocked was the leader of the Sea King Clan.
"I have already used 50% of my strength. How can your body be so strong?"
"Actually, you can do your best."
"Full force?"
"Are you sure?"
"I'll attack with all my strength. If I can't move well, it will kill me."
"With all our strength, you and I will do our best."
"The final blow!"
Hearing Chen Changan's words, the leader of the Sea King clan hesitated for a moment, but seeing Chen Changan's firm eyes, he finally nodded.
"Okay!"
"You come first, or me?"
"You first!"
"Then be careful!"
The leader of the Sea King Clan had an extremely serious expression at this time. He mobilized all his cultivation skills and unleashed his full blow.
